Definition: a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol
BiblicalUsage: 1) image; 1a) images (of tumours, mice, heathen gods); 1b) image, likeness (of resemblance); 1c) mere, empty, image, semblance (fig.)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
